title: SOTA: Stock Options Trading Agents Guided by Option-Implied Return Distributions

claim.summary: SOTA post-trains Qwen3.8-27B with teacher-trajectory SFT and GRPO to choose among nine option-strategy families from a point-in-time option-implied market state, while deterministic resolvers turn each choice into contracts, position sizes and delta hedges.

modules.name: Option-strategy actions with deterministic resolvers
modules.scope_reason: The action space is nine option-strategy families with tenor and delta-grid parameters, and resolvers map them to contracts, sizes and hedges, a contract tied to the option-trading output.
evidence_locators: PDF p.2; passage beginning "We formulate option trading as"
PDF p.5; passage beginning "To avoid querying prices for"

modules.name: Point-in-time option-implied market state
modules.scope_reason: The state derives trailing realized volatility, implied-volatility level, change, term structure, skew and curvature per underlying at each decision date, features chosen for option-return trading rather than reusable across task families.
evidence_locators: PDF p.5; passage beginning "For each underlying, the state"

modules.name: Anonymized teacher-trajectory SFT and portfolio-return GRPO
modules.scope_reason: Supervised fine-tuning on frontier-teacher trajectories and GRPO on log portfolio-value reward update the language model policy itself.
evidence_locators: PDF p.5; passage beginning "We train the policy in"
PDF p.7; passage beginning "To reduce temporal and identity"
